personalReset: Personal layout reset to organization default.
newTilesAvailable: New catalog tiles are available: {{ids}}. Open Customize to add them.
unknownTileIds: Saved layout references unknown tile ids: {{ids}}. They are skipped.
noTilesVisible: No dashboard tiles are visible for your permissions. The server omits unauthorized tiles entirely.
permissionDenied: You do not have permission for this dashboard action.
customizeIntro: Reorder with Move up / Move down. Retitle, chart type, filters, and time window (only where the tile supports a window) are presentation overlays — honesty notes stay shipped.
allTilesPlaced: Every catalog tile you can see is already on this layout.

defense.loadFailed: Blocked-attack data could not be loaded. Try again or check permissions.
defense.reportIntro: Blocked and failed attempts against this server, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. The numbers describe recorded events, not that an attacker ran commands or left malware.
defense.coverageSummary: {{techniques}} technique(s) in {{tactics}} tactic(s). Cards appear only when a mapped deny or failure exists.
defense.noTechniques: No mapped techniques in this window. Cards appear only when a mapped deny or failure exists.
defense.noSourceAddresses: No source addresses in this window.
defense.noUsernames: No attempted usernames in this window.
defense.noPasswordClasses: No password classes recorded. Values are never stored.
defense.noBlockedCommands: No governed command denies in this window.
defense.noBlockedRoutes: No API-route denies in this window.
defense.kpiEmpty: No recorded events for this measure in the selected window.
defense.honestyDelivery: These numbers describe blocked and failed attempts against this server. They are not proof that attackers ran commands or left malware.
defense.honestyPasswords: Password bars show class and length only. Attempted password values are never stored or shown.
defense.honestyGeo: The GeoIP country database is not installed. The heat map stays visible with an Absent note. Install it under Access Control → GeoIP.
defense.honestyCountryFilter: Lists and measures are filtered to country {{code}}. The heat map still shows the full window.
defense.honestyCommandsNoCountry: Blocked PAM commands are not tagged by country. This bar stays empty while a country filter is on.
defense.honestyUnknownGeo: Every event resolved as Unknown (ZZ). Country intensity is not invented.

denied_sessions.live: Sessions this server denied or that failed to start in this window. Not a count of successful logons.
denied_sessions.absent: No denied or failed sessions were recorded in this window. The ledger was readable.

failed_logons.live: Sign-in attempts this server rejected or that failed in this window.
failed_logons.absent: No failed or denied sign-in attempts were recorded in this window. The ledger was readable.

unique_ips.live: Distinct source addresses seen on denied or failed events in this window.
unique_ips.absent: No source addresses appeared on denied or failed events in this window.

blocked_commands.live: SSH or PAM commands this server blocked under command governance in this window.
blocked_commands.absent: No governed commands were denied in this window. A country filter hides this count because commands are not tagged by country.

threat_intel.live: Sign-in denies that matched a threat-intel list in this window. This is a deny count, not captured malware.
threat_intel.absent: No threat-intel denies in this window. This card is empty on purpose. This product is not a malware sample locker.

attack_techniques.live: Distinct MITRE ATT&CK techniques mapped from denied or failed events in this window.
attack_techniques.absent: No denied or failed events mapped to an ATT&CK technique in this window.

blocked_routes.live: API requests this server denied in this window, counted by route.
blocked_routes.absent: No API-route denies were recorded in this window.

defense.operationsHonesty: These numbers describe product delivery and recorded work. They are not an assessment verdict.
defense.operationsLoadFailed: Operations compliance could not be loaded. Try again or check your permissions.
defense.noNamedGap: No named gap for this family.
defense.openPoamHint: Open POA&M items exist. Open the POA&M register to continue recorded findings.
